item.text: This project uses Next 16 Cache Components, which has a route-stage `prefetch()` API for this case. I’m going to defer the related-products section out of the App Shell, enable partial prefetching, and mark only the featured link for a full prefetch so its related products are fetched before the click.

item.text:
Related products now stay out of the product page’s default App Shell prefetch. The featured-product link explicitly prefetches the full route, so the cached related products can be ready before navigation.

I added a Suspense boundary around the related-products section in [app/product/page.tsx](/workspace/app/product/page.tsx), enabled partial prefetching in [next.config.ts](/workspace/next.config.ts), and set `prefetch={true}` on the featured link in [app/page.tsx](/workspace/app/page.tsx).

I did not run tests or a build.
